# Gradle Wrapper

`gradle-wrapper.jar`, `../../gradlew` and `../../gradlew.bat` are Gradle build-tool
components, retained to make Android builds reproducible. They are licensed
under the [Apache License 2.0](../../../../../licenses/Apache-2.0.txt), independently
of RushLink's own license.

The launch scripts retain their original notice:

> Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.

`gradle-wrapper.properties` selects the Gradle distribution and verifies its
checksum. Gradle source and distribution information is available at
<https://github.com/gradle/gradle>. Keep the original notices when updating the
wrapper.
